verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI's own README says you can configure MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend it with custom tools, and that MCP servers connect new capabilities such as Imagen, Veo or Lyria media generation. The official docs also list a built-in /mcp command for managing them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP integration, and documentation depth on transports, auth and per-server tool controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Configure MCP servers in ~/.gemini/settings.json to extend Gemini CLI with custom tools
Use MCP servers to connect new capabilities, including media generation with Imagen, Veo or Lyria
